md4c v0.6.0 (commit 7fc1815a5eeba2af7d6120a76202bf59f3b6e6e4)
https://github.com/mity/md4c — MIT license, see LICENSE.md

Local patches (search md4c.c for "mdview patch"), all aimed at matching
github.com (cmark-gfm) output:

1. Tables: the header row may be the last line of a paragraph (the paragraph
   is split), and a table is only recognized if the header row has the same
   number of cells as the delimiter row (GFM spec).
2. Footnote references inside table cells were counted twice (once while the
   row was scanned for cell boundaries), producing duplicate back-references.
3. Extended (permissive) URL/WWW autolinks follow the GFM "extended autolink
   path" rules: the path runs up to whitespace or '<', then trailing
   punctuation (?!.,:*_~), unbalanced ')' and a trailing entity-like "&x;"
   are excluded.
